examples.english: In the past, it was rare for female students to attend university, but now they make up half.

notes:
A straightforward compound of ⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧ (female, woman) + ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧ (student). Used in both formal and neutral contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女子学生|じょしがくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧: proportion of female students
- {女子学生|じょしがくせい}{向|む}け: aimed at female students
- {女子学生|じょしがくせい}{寮|りょう}: women's dormitory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{男子学生|だんしがくせい}→男子学生：26705_danshigakusei⟧: male student — the counterpart
- ⟦{女子大生|じょしだいせい}→女子大生：23937_joshidaisei⟧: female university student — specifically refers to college/university level
- {女生徒|じょせいと}: female pupil — used for middle school and high school students
- {女学生|じょがくせい}: schoolgirl — a slightly older term with similar meaning
